why: #33483: a window restored on a workspace of a paused Cloud machine resumes it and shows CloudMachineProgressView until the workspace is mirrored, instead of a blank pane. It is window content wiring (WindowController, WindowManager presentation, WindowInvariants) over App-only types (CloudMachineSession, CloudMachineProgressView, WindowController), so the 18 lines stay with the window code in the App; the resume itself is the existing CloudMachineSession.attach path.
